Container.Name: mixarr
Container.Overview:
Mixarr is a fully self-contained music discovery and library management tool that integrates with Lidarr.
This is an all-in-one container that includes everything needed to run - no external database or Redis required!
Features: - Multi-Service Integration: Spotify, TIDAL, Deezer, Last.fm, MusicBrainz, Plex/Tautulli - Automated Subscriptions: Scheduled sync from connected services - AI-Powered Discovery: Get recommendations based on your library - PWA Support: Installable app with offline capabilities - Built-in MariaDB and Redis - no external dependencies needed
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: lidarr music spotify tidal deezer lastfm plex discovery recommendation

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent data storage (database, Redis data, SSL certificates). All application data is stored here.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Random secret string for session encryption. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Frontend URL
Config.Description: Public URL where Mixarr is accessible. Used for OAuth callbacks (Spotify, etc). Example: https://192.168.1.100:3443

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Same as Frontend URL. Leave empty to auto-use FRONTEND_URL value.

Container.Changes: ### 2026-01-04 - Initial Unraid Community Apps release - Fully self-contained: includes MariaDB, Redis, API, Web UI, and Caddy - No external database or Redis required - Multi-architecture support (amd64, arm64) - All data persisted in single /data volume
